_doc: Geometry questions that ask to see no picture, as a tutorial asks them. draw: a figure helps teach it. sides: named lengths the figure must keep in proportion; angles: named angles (degrees) the figure must show at that vertex.

cases.prompt: Triangle ABC has sides AB = 7 cm, BC = 8 cm and CA = 9 cm. Find its largest angle.
